title: auth: ORG_ROLE_LABELS has no `external` entry, so after objectstack#25233 stage 1 adds the role to BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLES the console no longer type-checks — objectstack Console Pin Gate and Spec Shape Gate are red
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** objectstack 19:02 合入的「外部组织角色」（objectstack#25233 第一阶段，PR #25515）在协议的内置成员角色里新增了 `external`。objectui `packages/auth/src/org-roles.ts` 的 `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` 是按角色写全的表，少了这一项，控制台因此编译失败。objectstack 主干的 Console Pin Gate 和 Spec Shape Gate 两个检查都红了。
- **要做：** 补上 `external` 的标签项和各语言翻译，并按 #25233 的裁决确认这个角色在各处的显示和权限档位。
- **完成标准：** objectui 对着 objectstack 当前 `main` 能通过类型检查；之后 objectstack 换 objectui 版本，两个检查转绿。

**Filing gate ① a measured defect** that keeps objectstack `main` red. Filed by the objectstack triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, R618). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** **p1**: the objectstack main-red fix, and it blocks the 18.1.0 cut. `domain:ui`, `area:identity`, `bug`.

## Measured

- **objectstack hourly `CI` 40015953606** on `1ff43b67ea` (20:01Z): `Console Pin Gate` failed at "Build the Console SPA at the pinned objectui SHA". The error is in `packages/auth`, `pnpm run build`:
  > Property 'external' is missing in type '{ owner …; admin …; delegated_admin …; member … }' but required in type 'Record<"admin" | "member" | "external" | "owner" | "delegated_admin", …>'.
- **objectstack `Spec Shape Gate` 40014906665** (19:53Z) reports the same error: `TS2741` at `packages/auth/src/org-roles.ts:67:14`, compiled against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main`.
- **The cause** is objectstack `9019af9fe6`, "feat(security): an external organization role" (#25515), which touches `packages/spec/src/identity/membership-role.ts`. The last green hourly run was 19:01Z on `aa2dbab7b6`.

## Landing (objectui `origin/main`)

- `packages/auth/src/org-roles.ts`: `ORG_ROLE_LABELS: Record<OrgRole, …>` (~:67) needs an `external` entry, for example `organization.roles.external`. Add the key to every shipped locale pack.
- **Read objectstack#25233's ruling (letter B) before choosing the rest.** `ORG_ROLES` is `[...BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLES]`, so `external` now appears wherever the console lists roles, including the invite and role pickers. Also choose where it sits on the grade ladder (~:80). Fail-closed reads it as no higher than `member`, since an external member reaches data only through explicit grants. Report those two choices.
- Any other exhaustive `Record<OrgRole, …>` or `switch` over the role type gets the same treatment. The type check finds them.

## Done when

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth build` and the console type-check pass against objectstack `main`'s spec.
- The `external` label renders in en and zh-CN, and there is a test for the role table.
- The objectstack pin move that follows is objectstack-ai/objectstack#25537.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

The objectui issues and PRs updated since 2026-10-23T19:00Z, matched on `external`, `org-roles` and `role`: none. **New.**
